title: A file holding the archive of one part of the specification
$comment: The archive holds the nodes that have ever been approved and have since been removed (s-f2b5zvc565s242f). The schema requires only what s-hw84ynkvhgzcnpr lists: a node of the archive has a location, a kind and the reason for its removal, and it has no sid, no node under it and no link pointing at it (s-bpdqd9v72wg7vsz). It admits every other property of the node with any value, so that a node removed in an earlier release, or a node of a kind that is no longer defined, still passes the schema.

schemaVersion.$comment: The version of this structure that the file follows, as in a file of the specification.

scope.$comment: The part of the specification the archived nodes were removed from.

section.$comment: The name of the file within the archive.

nodes.$comment: The archived nodes, in the order they were archived.

archivedNode.$comment: A removed node as it was when it was removed, with the reason for its removal. It has no sid, so that nothing can cite it: a node may be deleted from the archive at any time.

refs.$comment: Only the node's outgoing links: no link points at it.

archived.$comment: When and why the node was removed, and, where it names a replacement, the sid of the node that replaced it when it was removed (s-f2b5zvc565s242f). Nothing keeps that sid up to date.
